summary: Implementation Design materialized security-center-event-observation-panel-v1 architecture contracts, six explicit Web e2e acceptance entrypoints, a critical non-explicit contract guard, and expected failing signals for Coding/Repair. The strengthened acceptance design freezes default latest 24h behavior when no range is supplied and freezes failed-reception time-range membership to backend receivedAt. Current production deploy/api and deploy/web already implement Security Event Ingestion V1 records, but do not yet implement the observation-panel read model at GET /security-center/v1/operator/event-observation-panel or the /security-event-observation Web route, so the new explicit entrypoints are intentionally failed and must be repaired without editing the frozen tests or harness.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real-app subprocess acceptance entrypoint: authenticate an employee, delegate a high-risk action through the agent/plugin/tool path, and provide the required confirmation through the protected harness.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Security Center and the audit query surface must expose a continuous user -> agent -> plugin -> tool evidence chain with a durable confirmation artifact digest and no anonymous or fallback-system identity link.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real-app subprocess acceptance entrypoint: execute three high-risk actions to create a multi-record committed audit baseline, edit the second committed non-tail audit record by operating-system means while later records remain present, then attempt another high-risk action without manual trust recovery.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The system must detect historical-record ledger divergence before releasing the next high-risk boundary, raise one business-level data-continuity anomaly, enter local UNTRUSTED lock mode, refuse sensitive tooling, and keep the frozen Security Center backend plus operator-web observation surfaces recovery-required or UNTRUSTED rather than CLEAR until full-chain cloud validation succeeds.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real-app subprocess acceptance entrypoint: let a trusted client miss the lease window, observe denied rejoin before missing-gap verification, then drive the distinct recovery control point and restored-access attempt.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Security Center must mark the same canonical client UNTRUSTED after lease expiry, the pre-recovery console status must show denied rejoin before proof, the recovery control point must accept full-chain missing-gap validation, and the post-recovery trust projection plus console access must become ALIGNED or TRUSTED/200 only after continuity validation.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real-app subprocess acceptance entrypoint: establish trusted audit-head continuity, stop the runtime through a normal offline path without mutating local audit evidence, restart the same canonical client before lease expiry, and attempt ordinary model access.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Security Center backend and operator web must show the same canonical client as ALIGNED or TRUSTED with gap_status=CLEAR, recovery_gate_status=CLEAR, recovery_required=false, no missing-gap validation incident, and ordinary model access must return 200.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real-app subprocess acceptance entrypoint: submit nested deceptive instructions claiming test or maintenance mode while targeting a High risk tool without trusted provenance or confirmation.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The high-risk tool must remain blocked at the tool-call boundary, rejection must be recorded as durable security evidence with trace-bound nonce semantics, and Security Center/operator surfaces must expose the rejected attempt rather than silently executing.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run extension/run-integrity-delivery-selftest.py to execute all extension-owned Integrity Protection self-test nets (rule integrity, persona baseline, health check) across wiring, backend, and frontend layers.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: All delivery nets pass; rule-integrity backend in the self-test manifest still verifies LF-canonical and CRLF-only ok branches plus semantic tamper through extension/rule_integrity/tests/test_rules_integrity.py.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit a legal endpoint_edr malware_detected event with valid schemaVersion, required business fields, caller-supplied occurredAt, severity, summary, and payload, then query list/detail immediately.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The API must return success with duplicate=false only after durable persistence, list/detail must expose the event by sourceSystem plus eventId, and receivedAt must be generated by the backend rather than trusted from request input.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently has no POST /security-center/v1/events, GET /security-center/v1/operator/events, or stable event detail route, so the harness reports Security_Event_Ingestion_API_Missing.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit source allow-list, disabled source, source-to-type authorization, unknown event type, schemaVersion, base required summary, required payload field, payload type, and payload enum violations.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Each request must return a clear business failure reason, none may enter accepted events, and each must create a failed reception record with received time, submitted source/type, failure reason, and bounded request summary.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently lacks event contract validation and failure reception record routes, so rejection and failed-record observations report Security_Event_Ingestion_API_Missing.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit a legal event with configured fields plus collectorBuildFingerprint, which is not declared by deploy/config/security-event-contracts.v1.json.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The event must be accepted; configured fields remain list/detail primary fields; the undefined field is absent from list columns and present only in undefined-fields detail and raw payload.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently lacks accepted-event persistence, configured-field projection, undefined-field separation, and raw-payload detail routes.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit the same normalized sourceSystem plus eventId twice, then conflicting same-key content, then the same eventId from a different sourceSystem.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Identical repeat must return duplicate=true without a second accepted event; conflicting same-key submissions must be rejected and recorded; different sourceSystem plus same eventId must be accepted distinctly.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently lacks sourceSystem plus eventId idempotency storage, duplicate response semantics, conflict rejection, and conflict failed-record persistence.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: seed multiple accepted events, open the operator Web inbox, apply source/type/severity/time filters, and navigate to the stable sourceSystem plus eventId detail URL.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The Web/API inbox must default to receivedAt descending, source/type/severity/time filters must return only matching rows, event type display name and configured list payload fields must be visible, stable detail URLs must reopen the same event, and detail must show base facts, structured payload, undefined fields, and bounded read-only raw payload.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/web currently has no Security Event Inbox route and deploy/api has no event list/detail API for the Web page to consume.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit disallowed source/type, schema failure, payload failure, create an accepted idempotency baseline, submit conflicting same-key content, use test-only X-QwenPaw-Test-Persistence-Failure persistence failure injection, and submit oversized illegal payload cases.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Accepted event list must stay clean except for the intentional idempotency baseline, illegal/idempotency-conflict/persistence-error/oversized-invalid branches must each have queryable bounded failure records, persistence failure must return failure instead of success and stay out of business events, and oversized invalid payload handling must avoid unbounded storage or page display.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently lacks failed reception records, persistence-error simulation handling, oversized invalid payload bounding, and event-list cleanliness guarantees.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit five accepted events inside latest 24h across endpoint_edr and cloud_siem, malware_detected and correlation_rule_match, and multiple severities with exactly two HIGH events, then open /security-event-observation and call the observation-panel API without an explicit range.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The default observation panel response must be equivalent to explicit range=24h and must show total accepted events 5, HIGH accepted events 2, sourceSystem distribution endpoint_edr=3 and cloud_siem=2, and eventTypeId distribution malware_detected=3 and correlation_rule_match=2 without counting failed receptions.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: deploy/api currently lacks GET /security-center/v1/operator/event-observation-panel and deploy/web lacks /security-event-observation, so the harness reports Security_Event_Observation_Panel_API_Missing or Security_Event_Observation_Panel_Web_Missing.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit one DEBUG, one LOW, one MEDIUM, and one HIGH accepted event, then open the observation panel.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The alert list must include only MEDIUM and HIGH accepted events, while DEBUG, LOW, MEDIUM, and HIGH successful receptions all remain visible in rawRecords.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: the observation panel read model and Web route are not implemented, so alert severity scope cannot be observed.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit interleaved HIGH and MEDIUM accepted events with distinct occurredAt timestamps, then open the observation panel alert list.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: All HIGH alerts must appear before MEDIUM alerts, and same-severity alerts must be ordered by occurredAt descending.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: the observation panel read model has not implemented severity-priority plus occurredAt-descending alert ordering.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit invalid events for illegal source, missing required summary, and payload type error, then open the observation panel raw reception list.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: Failed receptions must not increase accepted-event summary counts and must not appear as alerts, but rawRecords must show each failed reception with failure reason and bounded raw-payload summary.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: the observation panel read model has not implemented failed reception raw-record projection without legal-event summary or alert pollution.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: submit one HIGH accepted event, open the observation panel, and select/focus that alert by sourceSystem plus eventId.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: The raw reception list must focus the same sourceSystem plus eventId raw record and expose bounded raw-payload evidence for the selected alert.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: the observation panel read model has not implemented focusSourceSystem/focusEventId focusedRawRecord traceability.

explicitEntrypoints.controlPoint: Run the frozen real Security Center API/Web subprocess entrypoint: seed accepted events by occurredAt and failed receptions by backend receivedAt inside latest 1h, inside latest 24h, inside latest 7d, and outside latest 7d, then switch the panel among 1h, 24h, and 7d quick ranges.
explicitEntrypoints.observationPoint: For each quick range, summary, alert list, and raw reception list must include only records in the same selected range; accepted records are ranged by occurredAt, failed receptions are ranged by backend receivedAt, and records outside that range are excluded.
explicitEntrypoints.failureReason: Expected first failure: the observation panel read model has not implemented shared 1h/24h/7d range semantics across summary, alerts, and rawRecords.

codingTargets.nextAction: Implement deploy/api event intake, durable-before-success persistence, backend-generated receivedAt, accepted event list/detail query, and duplicate=false response for legal configured events.

Implement deploy/config/security-event-contracts.v1.json loading, source allow-list and enabled checks, source-to-eventType authorization, unknown event type rejection, schemaVersion lookup, base required summary validation, payload required/type/enum validation, and failed reception record persistence.
Persist undefined payload fields separately from configured structured payload fields, exclude undefined fields from list columns, and expose them only in detail undefined/raw payload areas.

Implement sourceSystem plus eventId idempotency with normalized content comparison, duplicate=true identical repeat behavior, conflict rejection with failure record, and cross-source eventId independence.

Implement deploy/web Security Event Inbox list/filter/detail routes backed by deploy/api, including receivedAt-descending ordering, source/type/severity/time filter correctness, core fields, event type display name, configured list payload fields, stable detail URL, detail base facts, structured payload, undefined fields, and bounded raw payload rendering.

Implement failed reception records for illegal submissions, real idempotency conflict, test-injected persistence failure, and oversized invalid payload cases while keeping accepted event list clean except for the intentional idempotency baseline and keeping request summaries bounded.

Implement deploy/api observation-panel read model and deploy/web /security-event-observation route so default no-range behavior equals latest 24h, current 24h accepted-event posture summary counts only legal accepted events, and sourceSystem/eventTypeId distributions are reported.
Implement observation-panel alerts as HIGH/MEDIUM accepted events only while keeping DEBUG/LOW accepted events in rawRecords.
Order observation-panel alerts by severity priority HIGH before MEDIUM and occurredAt descending within each severity.
Project failed reception records into rawRecords with failure reason and bounded raw-payload summary while excluding them from accepted-event summary and alerts.
Implement focusSourceSystem/focusEventId handling and focusedRawRecord so alert selection deterministically locates the same raw evidence record.
Implement latest 1h, 24h, and 7d quick-range filtering consistently across summary, alerts, and rawRecords, with latest 24h as the default and failed receptions ranged by backend receivedAt.

taskExecutionPlan.executionStrategy: Preserve all frozen explicit test bodies and protected harness vocabulary. Implement production behavior under deploy/api and deploy/web only, using deploy/api as the single observation-panel read-model owner and deploy/web as a read-only operator consumer.

tasks.title: Implement observation panel read model
tasks.objective: Add deploy/api GET /security-center/v1/operator/event-observation-panel over existing accepted-event and failed-reception stores.
steps: Add the observation-panel API route with range values 1h, 24h, and 7d, defaulting to latest 24h when no range query is supplied.
Compute summary only from accepted legal events inside the selected range.

Return rawRecords from accepted events plus failed reception records inside the same selected range, using accepted-event occurredAt for accepted rows and backend receivedAt for failed reception rows.
tasks.completionSignal: The six observation-panel entrypoints no longer report Security_Event_Observation_Panel_API_Missing.

tasks.title: Implement alert and raw evidence semantics
tasks.objective: Close alert scope, alert ordering, failed reception visibility, and alert-to-raw traceability semantics in deploy/api.
steps: Include only HIGH and MEDIUM accepted events in alerts.
Sort alerts HIGH before MEDIUM, then occurredAt descending within each severity.
Project failed receptions into rawRecords with failureReason and bounded rawPayloadSummary without adding them to summary or alerts.
Implement focusSourceSystem/focusEventId and focusedRawRecord for deterministic alert-to-raw traceability.
tasks.completionSignal: Alert scope, ordering, failed reception visibility, and alert-to-raw traceability entrypoints pass without altering frozen tests.

tasks.title: Implement operator observation panel
tasks.objective: Add deploy/web /security-event-observation route and rendering backed only by deploy/api.
steps: Render default latest 24h summary when no explicit range is supplied, quick range controls for 1h/24h/7d, HIGH/MEDIUM alerts, raw reception records, and focused raw evidence.
Consume deploy/api observation-panel responses only; do not read deploy/config or backend store directly.
Do not add disposition, ticketing, assignment, approval, risk scoring, search, export, requester identity, or authentication UI.
tasks.completionSignal: The six Web e2e observation-panel entrypoints pass without altering their test bodies or harness vocabulary.

tasks.title: Validate observation panel handoff
tasks.objective: Prove the implementation satisfies frozen contracts, explicit entrypoints, and handoff validation.
steps: Run the six focused explicit Security Event Observation Panel entrypoints.
Run npm run validate:system-architecture and npm run validate:handoff:implementation.
Run npm run test:argo and ensure design/KG/test-failure-records.json no longer contains security-center-event-observation-panel-v1 failures.
tasks.completionSignal: All six observation-panel explicit entrypoints pass, architecture guard passes, validateStageHandoff passes, and Argo failure records are empty for security-center-event-observation-panel-v1.

openGaps: deploy/api currently lacks GET /security-center/v1/operator/event-observation-panel with no-range default latest 24h and 1h/24h/7d quick-range read-model semantics.

deploy/api currently lacks observation-panel summary, HIGH/MEDIUM alert scope, severity-plus-occurredAt ordering, failed-reception rawRecords, and focusSourceSystem/focusEventId focusedRawRecord traceability.

deploy/web currently lacks the /security-event-observation route and read-only panel rendering for default latest 24h, summary statistics, quick ranges, alerts, raw reception records, and alert-to-raw evidence focus.

The six Security Event Observation Panel V1 explicit entrypoints are expected to fail until Coding/Repair implements production behavior under deploy/api and deploy/web. They must not be converted to placeholder passing tests.
